name: gap_fade_5s
author: adapted from AI_Quant
thesis: This strategy fades large opening gaps. Empirically, many open gaps (>1%) tend to fill intraday, as initial momentum often retraces. It exploits behavioral overreaction at open. The inefficiency exists due to temporary mispricing of overnight information; it persists because traders hesitate to fade until pattern is proven (and overnight risk is resolved).
mechanism: Opening gaps trigger stop-loss cascades from overnight position holders, overshooting fair value. As the cascade exhausts, institutional VWAP algorithms begin working counter-gap orders, and fresh participants enter at the perceived discount or premium, driving price back toward the prior close or VWAP level within the first 15-30 minutes.
weaknesses: Some gaps are due to strong news and may continue trending
Risk of reversals if news is not fully priced at open
Limited signal frequency (requires significant gap at open)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
